BiblicalUsage: Zeiq is the Aramaic cry, a loud outcry from the throat. King Darius comes to the lions' den at dawn and cries out with a lamentable voice, asking Daniel whether the living God was able to deliver him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe that cry tells us more about Darius than about Daniel, because the king's hope was already fixed on the God he had just forbidden his people to pray to.
